standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: That was a mighty fine banana. Do you have any more?

standard-dialogue.player: I'm afraid that was the last one I had.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: And so can you. What's your point?

standard-dialogue.player: I mean, how can you speak? I thought you guys could only say things like 'ook ook'? Is it magic?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: When we decided to come here and thwart your Humans Against Monkeys operation, we made sure to obtain some amulets of humanspeak so that we could better intimidate you all.

standard-dialogue.player: I see... can I have your amulet of humanspeak?

using-cow-s-caged-monkey-on-an-affected-.text: There is already a monkey in that cage!
